blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Newly elected Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua on Friday called on all political leaders, including his opponents, to work with his administration in serving the Bangsamoro people. In his inaugural speech following his election over MP Ahod “Al Haj Murad” Ebrahim, chair of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) and his former political ally, Macacua vowed to continue the moral governance agenda championed by Ebrahim during his tenure as interim chief minister. “Sir, I want to personally assure you that the moral governance agenda you have started will remain at the very heart of my leadership.
